messages:
evelyn (customer): Hi team — our GCP Marketplace invoice for Feb (MP-2026-02-9981) shows a 'Redwood Inference - token usage' line for $3,120 (~1,250,000 tokens). Our Redwood dashboard (acct: redwood-acct-123) shows ~890k tokens for the same billing period. Can someone help reconcile? I attached the invoice PDF and a screenshot of the dashboard: https://weird.link/invoice-snap.png

maria (support): Sorry about that, @evelyn — flagged to billing. Can you paste the raw invoice line (text) and your marketplace subscription ID + GCP project ID? Also, do you have any multiple API keys or multiple deployments?

evelyn (customer): Invoice excerpt: `MP-2026-02-9981 | Redwood Inference | tokens | 1,250,000 | $3,120`
Subscription: `SUB-98765`, GCP project: `evelynco-prod`. We only use the hosted API and one API key (rotated once mid-Feb).

ashwin (billing): Thanks. Two quick hypotheses: 1) Marketplace metering can include duplicate/retry metering events or aggregated reporting differences. 2) There was a change in our metering adapter in mid-Feb that could have duplicated events for certain batched responses.

jeanne (eng): Adding: our dashboard token counts are derived from internal aggregated request logs (prompt+completion). Marketplace meter reports can differ if we send metering events per chunk or if events are retried. Also, we shipped a patch (adapter v2.3.1) around Feb 12-15 that re-sent batched KVs on flaky sockets — could cause duplicate metering events.

maria (support): @ashwin can you run a quick reconciliation query for SUB-98765 for 2026-02-01..2026-02-28? @jeanne can you check whether adapter v2.3.1 was active for hosted customers in that window?

ashwin (billing): Running now. SQL I used: ```SELECT metering_event_id, request_id, ts, tokens_reported, status FROM marketplace_metering WHERE subscription_id = 'SUB-98765' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28' ORDER BY ts;```

ashwin (billing): Preliminary: marketplace has 3,412 metering events in that window vs 2,855 usage events in platform logs. There are ~550 events with the same request_id and similar timestamps (within 2s). Looks like retries/duplicates.

evelyn (customer): We do client-side retries for 5xx with exponential backoff (max 2 retries). Not for 409. We did see a spike of errors around Feb 14.

jeanne (eng): Confirmed: adapter v2.3.1 had a double-submit on flaky connection scenarios; patch deployed Feb 15. Customers whose usage hit retries between Feb 12-15 could get duplicated metering events to marketplace. We should extract affected request_ids for SUB-98765 and prepare evidence for GCP.

ashwin (billing): I'll prepare a reconciliation CSV with columns: `metering_event_id, request_id, marketplace_ts, tokens_reported, platform_event_id`. That should be acceptable to GCP ops. Creating support case now.

billing-bot: Automated: Created billing case `BC-4521` for subscription `SUB-98765` referencing invoice `MP-2026-02-9981`. Attached preliminary CSV to case. Assigned to ashwin.

maria (support): @evelyn we'll need an authorization from your billing contact so we can request an adjustment on your behalf. Please provide name/email for your billing admin. Also attaching a short explainer for customers about marketplace adjustments: adjustments typically take 7-14 business days.

evelyn (customer): Billing contact: Liam <billing@evelynco.com>. I'll have him reply with authorization.

sam (acct mgmt): Looping in for customer care. If GCP takes time, we can consider a provisional credit while the case is open. FYI previous similar cases: provisional credits up to 50% of disputed amount are possible pending adjustment.

evelyn (customer): A provisional credit would be appreciated — thank you.

maria (support): Next steps: 1) @jeanne export duplicate event list for SUB-98765 (request_ids + tokens + timestamps). 2) @ashwin attach CSV + invoice + platform evidence to BC-4521 and submit to GCP Marketplace Ops. 3) @evelyn ask Liam to authorize Redwood to act for adjustment. 4) Sam will propose provisional credit in parallel. We'll update this thread when BC-4521 status changes.

jeanne (eng): Export queued — will drop CSV in BC-4521 and paste a sample here once ready.

ashwin (billing): Submitted packet to GCP ops (case link: https://gcp.support/cases/GC-67412). Asked for duplication removal for events that match our evidence.

maria (support): Marking triage done for now. ETA estimate from GCP: initial response 2-3 business days, resolution 7-14 business days. I'll ping here when we have confirmation. :white_check_mark:

evelyn (customer): Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast response.
